cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(crosspad_pc VERSION 0.4.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

# Compile-time feature overrides generated by the app manager from
# crosspad.config.json (gitignored working data). Carries only flags that
# deviate from the checked-in crosspad-core Configuration.h defaults, so an
# untouched checkout builds exactly as the headers say. Must stay above every
# target definition — directory compile definitions only reach targets created
# after they are set.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/.crosspad/build_flags.cmake")
    include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/.crosspad/build_flags.cmake")
    message(STATUS "CrossPad feature flags: set ${CROSSPAD_FLAGS_HASH}")
endif()

# First-run: generate .vscode/settings.json from template (idempotent)
if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/.vscode/settings.json"
   AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/.vscode/settings.template.json")
    find_program(_setup_vscode_python NAMES python3 python)
    if(_setup_vscode_python)
        execute_process(
            COMMAND "${_setup_vscode_python}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/scripts/setup_vscode.py"
            WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}"
        )
    endif()
endif()

# ── Which firmware this builds ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Unset: this repository's pinned crosspad-core, crosspad-gui, apps, LVGL and
# fonts -- the desktop simulator. Set to a platform-idf checkout: that
# firmware's own components, its LVGL (the ESP-IDF managed component) and its
# fonts, so what runs is what the board runs. The browser twin of a board is
# built this way (preset web-twin; the pages and tools: crosspad-web-twin).
set(CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "platform-idf checkout to build the firmware from (empty: this repository's pins)")
if(CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR)
    get_filename_component(CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}" ABSOLUTE BASE_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")
    set(CP_CORE_DIR "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/components/crosspad-core")
    set(CP_GUI_DIR  "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/components/crosspad-gui")
    set(CP_LVGL_DIR "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/managed_components/lvgl__lvgl")
    set(CP_FONT_DIR "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/main/fonts")
    file(GLOB CP_APP_DIRS LIST_DIRECTORIES true "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/components/crosspad-*")
    list(FILTER CP_APP_DIRS EXCLUDE REGEX "/crosspad-(core|gui|platform-idf)$")
    foreach(_need CP_CORE_DIR CP_GUI_DIR CP_LVGL_DIR CP_FONT_DIR)
        if(NOT EXISTS "${${_need}}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR: no ${${_need}} (run a firmware build there once: it fetches the managed LVGL)")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    # The board's lv_conf values (lv_conf.h) and the board's desk and status bar
    # (crosspad_app.cpp) instead of the simulator's.
    add_compile_definitions(CROSSPAD_BOARD_FIRMWARE=1)
    message(STATUS "Firmware from ${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}")
else()
    set(CP_CORE_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/crosspad-core")
    set(CP_GUI_DIR  "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/crosspad-gui")
    set(CP_LVGL_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/lvgl")
    set(CP_FONT_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/fonts")
    file(GLOB CP_APP_DIRS LIST_DIRECTORIES true "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/apps/crosspad-*")
endif()
# Apps a board has installed beside its firmware's own (the app manager puts
# them in components/ untracked): a twin of that board builds them too.
set(CROSSPAD_EXTRA_APPS "" CACHE STRING "More app directories to build (;-separated)")
foreach(_extra ${CROSSPAD_EXTRA_APPS})
    get_filename_component(_extra "${_extra}" ABSOLUTE BASE_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")
    get_filename_component(_extra_name "${_extra}" NAME)
    list(FILTER CP_APP_DIRS EXCLUDE REGEX "/${_extra_name}$")
    list(APPEND CP_APP_DIRS "${_extra}")
endforeach()
# ... and the ones not to build (directory names, ;-separated): a public build leaves out what a
# board installed for itself (crosspad-web-twin's CROSSPAD_PUBLIC=1).
set(CROSSPAD_EXCLUDE_APPS "" CACHE STRING "App directory names not to build (;-separated)")
foreach(_ex ${CROSSPAD_EXCLUDE_APPS})
    list(FILTER CP_APP_DIRS EXCLUDE REGEX "/${_ex}$")
endforeach()

# The browser build is a board's twin: the same firmware, fed the board's inputs.
if(EMSCRIPTEN AND NOT CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The browser build runs a board's firmware: set CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR to a platform-idf checkout (preset web-twin)")
endif()

# Set the correct FreeRTOS port for the current compiler
if(MSVC OR MINGW)
    set(FREERTOS_PORT MSVC_MINGW CACHE STRING "FreeRTOS port" FORCE)
else()
    set(FREERTOS_PORT GCC_POSIX CACHE STRING "FreeRTOS port" FORCE)
endif()

set(LVGL_PRO_PROJECT_DIR
    ""
    CACHE PATH "Path to LVGL Pro Project folder")

option(USE_MIDI "Enable MIDI input/output via RtMidi" ON)
option(USE_AUDIO "Enable system audio output via RtAudio" ON)
option(USE_BLE "Enable BLE MIDI via SimpleBLE" ON)
option(USE_VIRTUAL_AUDIO "Enable OS-visible virtual audio sinks (system mixer)" ON)

# FreeRTOS — always enabled (required for crosspad-core event bus & LVGL OSAL)
add_library(freertos_config INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(freertos_config SYSTEM INTERFACE ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/config)
target_compile_definitions(freertos_config INTERFACE projCOVERAGE_TEST=0)

if(NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
    add_subdirectory(FreeRTOS)
endif()

include_directories(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/include)
include_directories(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/config)

if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    # The browser: tasks are fibers on one thread (src/freertos/wasm/port.c).
    set(FREERTOS_PORT_DIR ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/freertos/wasm)
elseif(MSVC OR MINGW)
    set(FREERTOS_PORT_DIR ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/portable/MSVC-MingW)
else()
    set(FREERTOS_PORT_DIR ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/portable/ThirdParty/GCC/Posix)
endif()
include_directories(${FREERTOS_PORT_DIR})

file(GLOB FREERTOS_SOURCES
    "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/*.c"
    "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/portable/MemMang/heap_4.c"
    "${FREERTOS_PORT_DIR}/*.c"
)

# Main include files of the project
include_directories(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/main/inc)
# ESP-IDF header shims (esp_log, esp_timer, heap caps, FreeRTOS idf additions)
# for app code written against the board.
include_directories(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/compat)

# The simulator registers more built-in apps than a board (CITest, AppStore,
# MLPiano, Serial Monitor, Update); at the core's default of 16 the last ones --
# Settings and Update -- were silently dropped. Global: AppRegistry's size is in
# its header, so every translation unit has to agree on it.
add_compile_definitions(CROSSPAD_MAX_APPS=32)

# Define options for LVGL with default values (OFF)
option(LV_USE_DRAW_SDL "Use SDL draw unit" OFF)
option(LV_USE_LIBPNG "Use libpng to decode PNG" OFF)
option(LV_USE_LIBJPEG_TURBO "Use libjpeg turbo to decode JPEG" OFF)
option(LV_USE_FFMPEG "Use libffmpeg to display video using lv_ffmpeg" OFF)
option(LV_USE_FREETYPE "Use freetype library" OFF)

# Set C and C++ standards
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Set the output path for the executable
set(EXECUTABLE_OUTPUT_PATH ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/bin)
set(WORKING_DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR})

# Find and include SDL2 library (Emscripten brings its own port)
if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -sUSE_SDL=2")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -sUSE_SDL=2")
    set(SDL2_INCLUDE_DIRS "${EMSCRIPTEN_SYSROOT}/include/SDL2")
    set(SDL2_LIBRARIES "")
    # Web MIDI / WebAudio stand in for RtMidi / RtAudio (src/wasm/web_io.cpp).
    include_directories(${SDL2_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/wasm/shim)
else()
    find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED)
endif()

include(FetchContent)

# Suppress warnings from all third-party code (LVGL, RtMidi, RtAudio, etc.)
if(MSVC)
    set(_SAVED_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")
    set(_SAVED_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "/W[0-4]" "/w" CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "/W[0-4]" "/w" CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")
endif()

# ArduinoJson (header-only, required by crosspad-core settings)
FetchContent_Declare(
    ArduinoJson
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/bblanchon/ArduinoJson.git
    GIT_TAG        v7.3.0
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(ArduinoJson)

# MIDI support via RtMidi
if(USE_MIDI AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
    FetchContent_Declare(
        rtmidi
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/thestk/rtmidi.git
        GIT_TAG        6.0.0
    )
    set(RTMIDI_BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(RTMIDI_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(rtmidi)
    message(STATUS "MIDI support enabled (RtMidi)")
endif()

# Audio support via RtAudio
if(USE_AUDIO AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
    FetchContent_Declare(
        rtaudio
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/thestk/rtaudio.git
        GIT_TAG        6.0.0
    )
    set(RTAUDIO_BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    # Rename RtAudio's "uninstall" target to avoid collision with RtMidi's
    set(RTAUDIO_TARGETNAME_UNINSTALL "rtaudio-uninstall" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    # Keep dynamic CRT (/MDd) — don't let RtAudio switch to static /MT
    set(RTAUDIO_STATIC_MSVCRT OFF)
    # On Linux, enable PulseAudio backend so virtual-sink monitor sources are
    # discoverable by name. Requires libpulse-dev on the build host.
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
        set(RTAUDIO_API_PULSE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    endif()
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(rtaudio)
    message(STATUS "Audio support enabled (RtAudio)")
endif()

# Native PipeWire backend for virtual audio (Linux). Falls back to the pactl
# null-sink path at runtime when unavailable.
option(USE_PIPEWIRE "Native PipeWire virtual sinks/source (Linux)" ON)
set(CROSSPAD_PIPEWIRE_OK FALSE)
if(USE_PIPEWIRE AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" AND USE_AUDIO AND USE_VIRTUAL_AUDIO)
    find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
    if(PkgConfig_FOUND)
        pkg_check_modules(PIPEWIRE libpipewire-0.3)
    endif()
    if(PIPEWIRE_FOUND)
        set(CROSSPAD_PW_INCLUDE_DIRS ${PIPEWIRE_INCLUDE_DIRS})
        set(CROSSPAD_PW_LIBS ${PIPEWIRE_LINK_LIBRARIES})
        set(CROSSPAD_PIPEWIRE_OK TRUE)
    else()
        # Dev headers extracted without root (apt-get download + dpkg -x).
        set(_PW_LOCAL "$ENV{HOME}/.cache/crosspad/pw-dev/usr")
        set(_PW_SO "/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libpipewire-0.3.so.0")
        if(EXISTS "${_PW_LOCAL}/include/pipewire-0.3/pipewire/pipewire.h" AND EXISTS "${_PW_SO}")
            set(CROSSPAD_PW_INCLUDE_DIRS
                "${_PW_LOCAL}/include/pipewire-0.3"
                "${_PW_LOCAL}/include/spa-0.2")
            set(CROSSPAD_PW_LIBS "${_PW_SO}")
            set(CROSSPAD_PIPEWIRE_OK TRUE)
            message(STATUS "PipeWire: using local header prefix ${_PW_LOCAL}")
        else()
            message(STATUS "PipeWire dev headers not found — native virtual audio disabled (install libpipewire-0.3-dev)")
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

# BLE MIDI support via SimpleBLE
if(USE_BLE)
    # SimpleBLE 0.7.3 vendors an fmt older than 10, which uses MSVC's
    # stdext::checked_array_iterator -- gone from the STL since VS 2022 17.8.
    # It takes the fmt::fmt-header-only target instead when one exists.
    FetchContent_Declare(
        fmt
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt.git
        GIT_TAG        11.0.2
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(fmt)
    set_target_properties(fmt PROPERTIES EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL TRUE)
    FetchContent_Declare(
        simpleble
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/OpenBluetoothToolbox/SimpleBLE.git
        GIT_TAG        v0.7.3
        SOURCE_SUBDIR  simpleble
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(simpleble)
    # SimpleBLE sets /WX /W1 internally — override to suppress warnings. Its
    # WinRT backend still uses the /await coroutines, which VS 18 refuses
    # unless told it has been warned (STL1011).
    if(MSVC)
        foreach(t simpleble simpleble-c)
            if(TARGET ${t})
                target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE /w /WX-)
                target_compile_definitions(${t} PRIVATE _SILENCE_EXPERIMENTAL_COROUTINE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS)
            endif()
        endforeach()
    endif()
    message(STATUS "BLE support enabled (SimpleBLE)")
endif()

# Add compile definitions based on the selected options
add_compile_definitions($<$<BOOL:${LV_USE_DRAW_SDL}>:LV_USE_DRAW_SDL=1>)
add_compile_definitions($<$<BOOL:${LV_USE_LIBPNG}>:LV_USE_LIBPNG=1>)
add_compile_definitions($<$<BOOL:${LV_USE_LIBJPEG_TURBO}>:LV_USE_LIBJPEG_TURBO=1>)
add_compile_definitions($<$<BOOL:${LV_USE_FFMPEG}>:LV_USE_FFMPEG=1>)

# Force LVGL to build as static library (vcpkg sets BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON
# which breaks ThorVG linking — it can't resolve lv_realloc/lv_strdup/lv_zalloc
# when built as a separate DLL)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)

# Code includes "lvgl/lvgl.h": with an LVGL other than the submodule, that name
# has to reach it before the project root (where the submodule sits) does.
if(NOT CP_LVGL_DIR STREQUAL "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/lvgl")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lvgl_include")
    file(CREATE_LINK "${CP_LVGL_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lvgl_include/lvgl" SYMBOLIC)
    include_directories(BEFORE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lvgl_include")
endif()
add_subdirectory(${CP_LVGL_DIR} lvgl)
target_include_directories(lvgl PUBLIC ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} ${SDL2_INCLUDE_DIRS})

# The Montserrat sizes this UI uses come from src/fonts/, not from LVGL: same
# TTF and the same LV_SYMBOL_* list, plus Latin-1 Supplement and Latin
# Extended-A, so a kit called "ŚWIĘTE SŁOWA" draws its own letters instead of
# a row of boxes. They keep LVGL's symbol names, so no call site changes --
# which means LVGL's own copies have to leave the build or the link ends in
# duplicate symbols. Regenerated by platform-idf's tools/fonts/generate.py;
# the firmware carries the same files.
file(GLOB CROSSPAD_FONT_SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/fonts/lv_font_montserrat_*.c)
# A firmware's own fonts win; sizes only the simulator uses stay ours.
if(NOT CP_FONT_DIR STREQUAL "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/fonts")
    set(_fonts "")
    foreach(_f ${CROSSPAD_FONT_SOURCES})
        get_filename_component(_n "${_f}" NAME)
        if(EXISTS "${CP_FONT_DIR}/${_n}")
            list(APPEND _fonts "${CP_FONT_DIR}/${_n}")
        else()
            list(APPEND _fonts "${_f}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    set(CROSSPAD_FONT_SOURCES ${_fonts})
endif()
get_target_property(_lvgl_srcs lvgl SOURCES)
list(FILTER _lvgl_srcs EXCLUDE REGEX "lv_font_montserrat_(10|12|14|16|18|24)\\.c$")
set_property(TARGET lvgl PROPERTY SOURCES ${_lvgl_srcs})

# Restore warning level for project code
if(MSVC)
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${_SAVED_C_FLAGS}")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${_SAVED_CXX_FLAGS}")
endif()

# ── crosspad-core portable sources (auto-discover, excluding platform-specific) ──
file(GLOB_RECURSE CROSSPAD_CORE_SOURCES ${CP_CORE_DIR}/src/*.cpp)
list(FILTER CROSSPAD_CORE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "EspEventBus\\.cpp$")
list(FILTER CROSSPAD_CORE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "SyncEventBus\\.cpp$")
list(FILTER CROSSPAD_CORE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "Stm32Manager\\.cpp$")
# FreeRtosEventBus.cpp stays — used as the event bus implementation

# ── crosspad-gui sources (auto-discover) ──
file(GLOB_RECURSE CROSSPAD_GUI_SOURCES ${CP_GUI_DIR}/src/*.cpp)

# ── Auto-reconfigure when source files are added/removed ──
# Ninja watches these directories and triggers cmake reconfigure on changes
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CP_CORE_DIR}/src"
    "${CP_GUI_DIR}/src"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/apps"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/pc_stubs"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/updater"
)

# ── PC platform stubs (event bus, singletons, interface impls) ──
set(PC_STUB_SOURCES
    src/pc_stubs/PcPlatformStubs.cpp
    src/pc_stubs/PcApp.cpp
    src/pc_stubs/PcHttpClient.cpp
)

)

                             src/wasm/twin_board.cpp)

    list(APPEND MAIN_LIBS freertos_config)

    list(APPEND MAIN_LIBS freertos_config freertos_kernel)

# Audio sources and libraries

    list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES src/audio/PcAudio.cpp src/audio/PcAudioInput.cpp src/audio/PcAudioModule.cpp)
    list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES src/audio/audio_platform.cpp)
    if(NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
        list(APPEND MAIN_LIBS rtaudio)
    endif()

    # Streaming sample engine — the desktop stand-in for the board's sample
    # player. Listed explicitly rather than globbed so a stray file in the
    # directory cannot join the build by accident.
    list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES
        src/audio/sampler/WavReader.cpp
        src/audio/sampler/SampleStreamEngine.cpp
        src/audio/sampler/SampleStreamPlayer.cpp
        src/audio/sampler/PcSampleNode.cpp
        src/audio/sampler/PcSamplerPort.cpp
        src/audio/sampler/PcPitchedPort.cpp
        src/sequencer/PcSequencer.cpp
        src/song/PcSongEnginePort.cpp
        src/sampletools/PcSampleToolsPort.cpp

    if(USE_VIRTUAL_AUDIO)
        list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES
            src/audio/virtual/VirtualSinkFactory.cpp
            src/audio/virtual/LinuxPipewireSinks.cpp
        )
        if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
            list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES
                src/audio/virtual/PulseMonitorCapture.cpp
            )
            # libpulse-simple is already pulled in transitively via RtAudio's
            # PULSE backend, but link explicitly so the build doesn't depend
            # on that detail.
            list(APPEND MAIN_LIBS pulse pulse-simple)
        endif()

        if(CROSSPAD_PIPEWIRE_OK)
            list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES
                src/audio/pipewire/PwContext.cpp
                src/audio/pipewire/PwVirtualSinkCapture.cpp
                src/audio/pipewire/PwVirtualSinkManager.cpp
                src/audio/pipewire/PwDefaultSinkGuard.cpp
                src/audio/pipewire/PwVirtualSource.cpp
                src/audio/pipewire/PwSinkEnumerator.cpp
            )
            list(APPEND MAIN_LIBS ${CROSSPAD_PW_LIBS})
            add_compile_definitions(USE_PIPEWIRE=1)
            # Headers are C99-style; include dirs needed by any TU that includes ours
            include_directories(${CROSSPAD_PW_INCLUDE_DIRS})
        endif()
    endif()

    # ML_SynthTools vendored FM synth engine
    set(ML_SYNTH_SOURCES
        lib/ml_synth/ml_fm.cpp
        lib/ml_synth/ml_status_stub.cpp
        lib/ml_synth/ml_utils_stub.cpp
    )

    # Synth engine wrapper (platform-level, like ESP32's audio codec)
    set(ML_PIANO_SYNTH_SOURCES src/synth/MlPianoSynth.cpp)

    list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES ${ML_SYNTH_SOURCES} ${ML_PIANO_SYNTH_SOURCES})
endif()

# ── Built-in apps (always present) ──────────────────────────────────────
# A board has Settings and Firmware, no CITest. In the browser the board's own
# two are built, their ESP half answered by src/wasm/board/ with the board's
# data (TWIN_INFO, TWIN_FW); on the desktop the simulator's.
if(CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR)
    set(_builtins settings update)
else()
    set(_builtins settings citest update)
endif()
set(CP_BUILTIN_APP_DIRS "")
if(CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR AND EMSCRIPTEN)
    set(_board_builtin_sources
        "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/main/app/settings/settings_app.cpp"
        "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/main/app/update/update_app.cpp")
    set_source_files_properties(${_board_builtin_sources} PROPERTIES
        INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/wasm/board;${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/main/app/update")
    list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES ${_board_builtin_sources})
    list(APPEND CP_BUILTIN_APP_DIRS "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/main/app/settings" "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/main/app/update")
else()
    foreach(_builtin ${_builtins})
        if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/apps/${_builtin}/CMakeLists.txt")
            add_subdirectory(src/apps/${_builtin})
            list(APPEND CP_BUILTIN_APP_DIRS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/apps/${_builtin}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES ${SETTINGS_APP_SOURCES} ${CITEST_APP_SOURCES} ${UPDATE_APP_SOURCES})
endif()

# ── Installable apps (submodules in src/apps/crosspad-*) ────────────────
set(_app_submodule_dirs ${CP_APP_DIRS})
foreach(_app_dir ${_app_submodule_dirs})
    if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${_app_dir}")
        continue()
    endif()
    get_filename_component(_app_name "${_app_dir}" NAME)

    # App Store is dev-only — skip when BUILD_TESTING is OFF (release builds)
    if(NOT BUILD_TESTING AND _app_name STREQUAL "crosspad-appstore")
        message(STATUS "Skipping dev-only app: ${_app_name}")
        continue()
    endif()

    # Each app also ships its own ESP-IDF CMakeLists.txt (idf_component_register
    # with its own SRCS glob) — a second, independent build description for the
    # same submodule. We don't execute that file here (that would mean either
    # emulating idf_component_register on PC or shelling out to CMake's IDF
    # extension, both a bigger refactor than this), but we at least mirror its
    # glob depth so a component that deliberately scopes its build to a flat
    # src/ (plain GLOB, no _RECURSE) can't have PC silently pull in an extra
    # subdirectory IDF was never told to compile. Default is recursive: most
    # apps are a single file in src/, but a larger one (the sampler) splits
    # into src/ui, src/logic, src/waveform, src/port, and a non-recursive glob
    # once picked up only its two top-level files and left every symbol they
    # referenced undefined at link time.
    set(_app_glob_recursive TRUE)
    if(EXISTS "${_app_dir}/CMakeLists.txt")
        file(READ "${_app_dir}/CMakeLists.txt" _app_cmake_txt)
        if(NOT _app_cmake_txt MATCHES "GLOB_RECURSE")
            set(_app_glob_recursive FALSE)
        endif()
    endif()
    if(_app_glob_recursive)
        file(GLOB_RECURSE _app_sources "${_app_dir}/src/*.cpp")
    else()
        file(GLOB _app_sources "${_app_dir}/src/*.cpp")
    endif()
    if(_app_sources)
        list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES ${_app_sources})
        # The browser twin builds the apps as the board does: their encoder
        # half and their other board-only paths sit behind ESP_PLATFORM
        # (src/compat answers the ESP headers they take; LV_KCONFIG_IGNORE keeps
        # LVGL from looking for an sdkconfig.h).
        if(CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR AND EMSCRIPTEN)
            set_source_files_properties(${_app_sources} PROPERTIES COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "ESP_PLATFORM=1;LV_KCONFIG_IGNORE=1")
        endif()
    endif()

    message(STATUS "App submodule: ${_app_name} (${_app_sources})")
endforeach()

# ── Runtime assets (bin/assets) ─────────────────────────────────────────
# The image loader prefers <exe dir>/assets, so stage the shared gui assets
# together with every app's own assets there. Without this an app that ships
# its own icon renders a blank launcher tile: only crosspad-gui/assets was ever
# on the search path, and an installed app's icon lives in its own repo.
set(_crosspad_asset_stage "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin/assets")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_crosspad_asset_stage}")
file(GLOB _crosspad_gui_assets "${CP_GUI_DIR}/assets/*.png")
set(_crosspad_app_asset_dirs "")
foreach(_dir ${CP_APP_DIRS} ${CP_BUILTIN_APP_DIRS})
    if(IS_DIRECTORY "${_dir}/assets")
        list(APPEND _crosspad_app_asset_dirs "${_dir}/assets")
    endif()
endforeach()
set(_crosspad_app_assets "")
foreach(_dir ${_crosspad_app_asset_dirs})
    file(GLOB _found "${_dir}/*.png")
    list(APPEND _crosspad_app_assets ${_found})
endforeach()
foreach(_asset ${_crosspad_gui_assets} ${_crosspad_app_assets})
    file(COPY "${_asset}" DESTINATION "${_crosspad_asset_stage}")
endforeach()
list(LENGTH _crosspad_app_assets _app_asset_count)
message(STATUS "Assets: staged shared + ${_app_asset_count} app asset(s) "
               "into bin/assets")

# Updater module (version check, download, self-update)
list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES src/updater/PcUpdater.cpp)

# Version header — always generated into build/generated/ from PROJECT_VERSION.
# CI can override via -DCROSSPAD_VERSION_OVERRIDE=x.y.z from git tag.
if(DEFINED CROSSPAD_VERSION_OVERRIDE)
    set(CP_VERSION "${CROSSPAD_VERSION_OVERRIDE}")
else()
    set(CP_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}")
endif()
message(STATUS "CrossPad version: ${CP_VERSION}")
configure_file(cmake/version.h.in "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/crosspad_pc_version.h" @ONLY)

# Submodule revisions for Settings -> Info, mirroring platform-idf. Best effort:
# a source tree without git (release tarball) simply reports "unknown".
function(crosspad_git_rev out_var dir)
    set(rev "unknown")
    execute_process(
        COMMAND git rev-parse --short HEAD
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${dir}"
        OUTPUT_VARIABLE rev_out
        OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
        ERROR_QUIET
        RESULT_VARIABLE rev_res)
    if(rev_res EQUAL 0 AND rev_out)
        set(rev "${rev_out}")
    endif()
    set(${out_var} "${rev}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

crosspad_git_rev(CROSSPAD_CORE_REV "${CP_CORE_DIR}")
crosspad_git_rev(CROSSPAD_GUI_REV  "${CP_GUI_DIR}")

else()

endif()
list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES "${APP_REGISTRY_FILE}")

      ${LVGL_PRO_PROJECT_DIR}  # local headers like ui.h, generated files, etc.

# Build-time inventory of installed apps and shared submodules (commit + pin).
# Same generator the firmware uses, so `--versions` here and APP_VERSIONS on a
# board answer in the same format.
include(${CP_CORE_DIR}/cmake/crosspad_app_versions.cmake)
set(_crosspad_app_manifest "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/apps.json")
if(CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR AND EXISTS "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/apps.json")
    set(_crosspad_app_manifest "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/apps.json")
endif()
crosspad_generate_app_versions(
    OUTPUT   "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/app_versions.cpp"
    SHARED   "${CP_CORE_DIR}"
             "${CP_GUI_DIR}"
    APPS     ${CP_APP_DIRS}
    MANIFEST "${_crosspad_app_manifest}")
list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/app_versions.cpp")

# A board's firmware: the source id of what the screen is built from, as the board's own
# build computes it (platform-idf tools/twin_source_id.cmake, TWIN_HELLO). Written now,
# and on every build by the target below (sources change without a reconfigure).
if(CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR AND EXISTS "${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/tools/twin_source_id.cmake")
    set(_twin_sid "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/twin_source_id.c")
    set(_twin_sid_cmd ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DFW=${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR} -DOUT=${_twin_sid}
                      -P ${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/tools/twin_source_id.cmake)
    execute_process(COMMAND ${_twin_sid_cmd})
    add_custom_target(twin_source_id COMMAND ${_twin_sid_cmd} BYPRODUCTS ${_twin_sid} COMMENT "twin source id")
    list(APPEND MAIN_SOURCES "${_twin_sid}")
endif()

add_executable(CrossPad ${MAIN_SOURCES})
if(TARGET twin_source_id)
    add_dependencies(CrossPad twin_source_id)
    target_compile_definitions(CrossPad PRIVATE TWIN_HELLO=1)   # else a firmware from before it
endif()
target_compile_definitions(CrossPad PRIVATE
    LV_CONF_INCLUDE_SIMPLE
    USE_LVGL=1
    CP_LCD_HOR_RES=320
    CP_LCD_VER_RES=240
    PLATFORM_PC=1
    CROSSPAD_REGISTER_APP_NAMED_FUNCTIONS=1
    CROSSPAD_CORE_REV="${CROSSPAD_CORE_REV}"
    CROSSPAD_GUI_REV="${CROSSPAD_GUI_REV}"
    CROSSPAD_PC_VERSION="${CP_VERSION}"
)
target_include_directories(CrossPad PRIVATE
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CP_CORE_DIR}/include
    ${CP_GUI_DIR}/include
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/ml_synth
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib
    ${CP_LVGL_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated
)
# Add include dirs from installable app submodules
foreach(_app_dir ${_app_submodule_dirs})
    if(IS_DIRECTORY "${_app_dir}/include")
        target_include_directories(CrossPad PRIVATE "${_app_dir}/include")
        # Also add the nested dir so apps can use short includes (e.g. "MixerApp.hpp")
        get_filename_component(_app_name "${_app_dir}" NAME)
        if(IS_DIRECTORY "${_app_dir}/include/${_app_name}")
            target_include_directories(CrossPad PRIVATE "${_app_dir}/include/${_app_name}")
        endif()
    endif()
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(CrossPad ${MAIN_LIBS})

if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    # The browser build: an ES module a page instantiates (crosspad-web-twin's
    # web/simtwin.js).
    # ASYNCIFY carries the fiber scheduler; sleeps inside tasks yield
    # (src/wasm/web_io.cpp); time() is the board's in a twin (wasm_bridge.cpp).
    # The pages that load it live in crosspad-web-twin, whose build sets both.
    set(CROSSPAD_WEB_OUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/web" CACHE PATH "Where the browser build (CrossPad.mjs/.wasm/.data) goes")
    # /assets: a board's assets partition when one was mirrored (a board can
    # run with an older one than its firmware; crosspad-web-twin
    # tools/pull_assets.py), else the images this tree stages.
    set(CROSSPAD_WEB_ASSETS "" CACHE PATH "A board's mirrored assets partition to preload as /assets (empty: bin/assets)")
    set(_web_assets "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin/assets")
    if(CROSSPAD_WEB_ASSETS AND EXISTS "${CROSSPAD_WEB_ASSETS}/.pulled")
        set(_web_assets "${CROSSPAD_WEB_ASSETS}")
        set_property(TARGET CrossPad APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS "${_web_assets}/.pulled")
    endif()
    message(STATUS "Web build -> ${CROSSPAD_WEB_OUT} (assets ${_web_assets})")
    set_target_properties(CrossPad PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".mjs" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CROSSPAD_WEB_OUT}")
    target_link_options(CrossPad PRIVATE
        -sUSE_SDL=2 -sASYNCIFY=1 -sASYNCIFY_STACK_SIZE=524288 -sSTACK_SIZE=4194304
        -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -sINITIAL_MEMORY=268435456
        -sMODULARIZE=1 -sEXPORT_ES6=1 -sEXPORT_NAME=CrossPadSim -sENVIRONMENT=web -sEXIT_RUNTIME=0
        -lidbfs.js -sFORCE_FILESYSTEM=1
        -Wl,--wrap=nanosleep -Wl,--wrap=time -Wl,--wrap=sched_yield
        -Wl,--wrap=pthread_create -Wl,--wrap=pthread_join -Wl,--wrap=pthread_detach
        "-sEXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=['_main','_malloc','_free']"
        "-sDEFAULT_LIBRARY_FUNCS_TO_INCLUDE=['$stringToNewUTF8']"
        "-sEXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=['HEAPU8','HEAPF32','FS','IDBFS','callMain','addRunDependency','removeRunDependency','stringToNewUTF8','UTF8ToString']"
        --preload-file "${_web_assets}@/assets"
    )
    # What the board and its twin both describe their screens with (TWIN_STATE).
    configure_file("${CROSSPAD_FIRMWARE_DIR}/main/include/twin_state.h" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/twin_state.h" COPYONLY)
endif()

# Winsock + COM (folder picker dialog) for Windows
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(CrossPad ws2_32 ole32 shell32 winhttp)

    # Copy SDL2.dll next to the exe so dev builds match release layout.
    # This ensures the auto-updater can swap exe+dll without PATH issues.
    find_file(SDL2_DLL_PATH SDL2.dll
        PATHS "${SDL2_DIR}" "${_VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/x64-windows/bin"
              "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/x64-windows/bin"
              "C:/vcpkg/installed/x64-windows/bin"
        NO_DEFAULT_PATH
    )
    if(SDL2_DLL_PATH)
        add_custom_command(TARGET CrossPad POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                "${SDL2_DLL_PATH}"
                "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:CrossPad>/SDL2.dll"
            COMMENT "Copying SDL2.dll to output directory"
        )
    endif()
endif()

target_compile_definitions(CrossPad PRIVATE USE_FREERTOS=1)

    target_compile_definitions(CrossPad PRIVATE CROSSPAD_DEV_BUILD=1)

        target_compile_definitions(CrossPad PRIVATE USE_VIRTUAL_AUDIO=1)
    endif()
    # Suppress warnings for vendored ML_SynthTools code

        set_source_files_properties(
            lib/ml_synth/ml_fm.cpp
            lib/ml_synth/ml_status_stub.cpp
            lib/ml_synth/ml_utils_stub.cpp

        )
    else()
        set_source_files_properties(
            lib/ml_synth/ml_fm.cpp
            lib/ml_synth/ml_status_stub.cpp
            lib/ml_synth/ml_utils_stub.cpp
            PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-w"
        )
    endif()

# which hides log output. This ensures a console is available for logging.
if (WIN32)
    if (MSVC)
        target_link_options(CrossPad PRIVATE "/SUBSYSTEM:CONSOLE")
    else()

# Apply additional compile options if the build type is Debug
if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
    message(STATUS "Debug mode enabled")

    if(NOT MSVC)
        target_compile_options(lvgl PRIVATE
            -pedantic-errors
            -Wall
            -Wclobbered
            -Wdeprecated
            -Wdouble-promotion
            -Wempty-body
            -Wextra
            -Wformat-security
            -Wmaybe-uninitialized
            # -Wmissing-prototypes
            -Wpointer-arith
            -Wmultichar
            -Wno-pedantic # ignored for now, we convert functions to pointers for properties table.
            -Wreturn-type
            -Wshadow
            -Wshift-negative-value
            -Wsizeof-pointer-memaccess
            -Wtype-limits
            -Wundef
            -Wuninitialized
            -Wunreachable-code
            -Wfloat-conversion
            -Wstrict-aliasing
        )
    endif()

if (ASAN)
    message(STATUS "AddressSanitizer enabled")

    # Add AddressSanitizer flags
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer")
    set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} -fsanitize=address")
    set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS} -fsanitize=address")
else()
    message(STATUS "AddressSanitizer disabled")
endif()
endif()
